title: Three Tests For French Spreads

Three Tests For French Spreads

Cedric Gemehl

Gavekal Research | 8 Oct 2026

After touching 150bp last Friday, October 2, the 10-year OAT-bund spread retraced to 127bp on Tuesday, before widening again to 139bp Thursday. Rather than beginning a meaningful tightening, the spread appears to be undergoing a repricing which is likely to see it settle somewhere between 125bp and 300bp (see How Wide Can French Spreads Get?). However, this is a remarkably broad range. So, what forces could push spreads towards either the floor or ceiling of this band over the coming months?Wednesday’s price action was a reminder that global bond markets will play a role. The French spread widened as much as 14bp during the day’s session as the global bond sell-off resumed, pushing US treasury yields higher. Equally, any rally in global bonds (see Reasons To Start Buying Bonds) could ease the widening pressure on French spreads. Whatever happens globally, however, idiosyncratic French risk is unlikely to disappear.
